text: Clear my name, God; I've kept an honest shop. I've thrown in my lot with you, God, and I'm not budging.
order your battery of tests. Make sure I'm fit inside and out
sight of your love, But keep in step with you, never missing a beat.
I don't pal around with thugs;
then join hands with the others in the great circle, dancing around your altar, God,
your house glows with your glory.
don't sweep me out with the quacks and crooks,
women with purses stuffed with bribe-money.
I bless you every chance I get.
